purpose: Preregister a small-sample quarterly predictive selection cycle for Romania NFC investment intensity before any coefficient estimation. The primary question is whether lagged real activity and a lagged marginal NFC financing-rate measure add predictive information beyond investment-rate persistence. A separately preregistered nested extension asks whether lagged D.92 investment-grant support adds further predictive information. This cycle is associational/predictive only and cannot activate System Dynamics feedback.

target.concept: NFC gross fixed capital formation as a percentage of NFC gross value added
target.interpretation: Investment intensity, not real investment growth.

lagged_financing_rate.role: marginal NFC RON financing-cost proxy for variable/up-to-one-year fixation
lagged_financing_rate.semantic_boundary: not the effective rate on the outstanding NFC debt stock and not a total-all-fixations rate

lagged_investment_grant_support.causal_status: not an identified policy shock and not EU-specific

information_timing.interpretation: One-quarter-ahead prediction from previously observed quarterly states. The design deliberately avoids same-quarter regressors to reduce simultaneity; it does not establish causal timing.

parameter_interpretation.beta_g: incremental conditional association of prior-quarter real activity with current NFC investment intensity; expected non-negative
parameter_interpretation.beta_r: incremental conditional association of the prior-quarter marginal new-business financing-rate proxy with current NFC investment intensity; expected non-positive

candidate_models.equation: Irate[t] = alpha + rho*Irate[t-1] + beta_g*RealGDPYoY[t-1] + beta_r*NFCNewBusinessRateUpTo1Y[t-1] + beta_s*InvestmentGrantSupport[t-1]
candidate_models.admission_rule: May be selected only if the primary core candidate passes and the augmented form independently passes all identifiability/domain gates and the frozen incremental-value gates versus the core form.

parameter_interpretation.beta_s: incremental conditional association of prior-quarter D.92 support intensity with current investment intensity; expected non-negative; not an EU-funds coefficient

fitting_method.missing_value_policy: No imputation. The retained panel is contiguous and finite; a target quarter is evaluable only when the target and all required t-1 inputs are finite.

windows.structural_selection_method: Expanding-origin one-quarter-ahead predictions. At each target quarter, each model is fitted only on earlier lagged target rows.
windows.final_evaluation_open_rule: Open final-evaluation performance only if the primary candidate passes every required selection/identifiability gate. If the primary passes, select the augmented extension only if it also passes its frozen incremental gates; otherwise the already-preregistered core form proceeds. If the primary fails, the final window remains unopened.
windows.sample_size_note: The retained panel contains only 34 quarterly rows. After one lag there are 33 target rows: 16 initial-calibration rows, 8 structural-selection origins and 9 untouched final-evaluation origins. Candidate size is capped at four parameters for the primary form and five for the preregistered nested extension.

identifiability_gates.rule: Rank, condition-number or coefficient-domain failure is an identification failure. Do not rescue a form by regularization, variable deletion, sign flipping, alternative lags, interactions or regime terms inside this cycle.

primary_structural_selection_gates.rule: The core candidate passes only if every identifiability, parameter-domain and predictive gate passes. Improvement over persistence alone is insufficient; incremental value over the estimated AR benchmark is mandatory.

augmented_extension_gates.rule: Failure of the augmented extension does not retroactively alter the preregistered primary candidate. It only means D.92 support is not admitted in this tested form.

final_evaluation_gates_if_opened.parameter_refit_policy: At each final-evaluation origin, refit only the frozen selected form on target rows strictly earlier than that target quarter; no form, lag, target, variable, threshold or sign domain may change.

robustness_diagnostics_not_selection_cri.note: Diagnostics may motivate a future separately preregistered cycle but may not respecify this cycle.

verdict_rules.PASS_CORE_TO_FINAL_EVALUATION: Primary core form passes; augmented extension fails or is not selected. Core form may enter the final-evaluation gate.
verdict_rules.PASS_AUGMENTED_TO_FINAL_EVALUATION: Primary core form passes and augmented extension also passes all incremental gates. Augmented form may enter the final-evaluation gate.
verdict_rules.FAIL_BEFORE_HOLDOUT: Primary core form fails any required structural-selection or identifiability gate; final holdout stays unopened.
verdict_rules.CANDIDATE_AFTER_FINAL_EVALUATION: Frozen selected form passes final predictive gates but remains a non-causal candidate. Separate validation and System Dynamics activation gates are still required.
verdict_rules.REJECT_TESTED_FORM: Frozen selected form fails permitted final evaluation. This rejects only the tested form in this cycle.

estimation_authorization.next_gate: Implement an offline runner that exactly enforces this frozen contract, add synthetic/unit tests and a default no-estimation guard. Only after CI passes may one bounded structural-selection execution be separately authorized.
